review_method: Fresh independent manual inspection of each of the eight listed candidate PNGs with tools.view_image. Only the assigned candidate images were loaded. Case sidecars, reference-scope text, HANDOFF text, and relevant prototype text were read without running an application or verification suite.

identity_verification.method: Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 on each current candidate PNG, compared with expected_png_sha256 and case_metadata.evidence_hashes.screenshot.sha256. Case metadata identifies the supplied run, binary, and source.

limitations: No independent reference PNG was assigned to this supplemental batch. The assessment uses reference-scope, HANDOFF, and matching prototype text for layout and UX expectations; it is not an image-to-image comparison.
The eight assigned files are desktop native Slint captures at 618 by 824 logical pixels. They are not photographs or physical e-ink captures at the 1236 by 1648 reference resolution.

Still images and recorded sidecars show the resulting states. They do not independently prove input timing, whole-control press feedback, every pointer event in outside dismissal, durable behavior after restart, or the membership of every off-screen filtered record. No application, test, build, smoke test, or runtime probe was executed by this reviewer.

In demo mode, visible_books.unread is a projected cover-update badge, as documented by the read-only src/app/view.rs book_item implementation and src/demo.rs badge comment; it is independent of the unread chapter count used by the library query. The include/exclude badge values are therefore not treated as an independent audit of filtering membership. The review confirms the displayed three-state contract, sidecar state cycle, and differing recorded page totals.
Real titles, counts, covers, progress, and dates may differ from handoff sample data. Those differences were not treated as geometry or clipping failures.

These PNGs do not qualify physical sleep/wake, a 512 MiB memory ceiling, hardware refresh waveforms, sensor behavior, unavailable hardware visibility, or authentication integration. Closed-reader artwork and its invisible hit zones are outside these eight cases.
This result covers only supplemental-06. It makes no claim that the complete round is clean or that any consecutive-clean-round requirement has been met.
